name: setup-node cache failure
hint: setup-node@v4 cache:'npm' is known to fail on GitHub runners. Remove cache:'npm' from setup-node action.

name: npm install failure
hint: Check package.json compatibility and Node version match.
fix: Verify Node version matches engines field

name: c8 coverage threshold breach
hint: Coverage dropped below threshold. Check coverage-report.json for per-suite details.
fix: Run coverage-trend.mjs --report to see which suite regressed

name: test assertion failure
hint: Test assertion failed. Check the specific test in test-output.txt.

name: node not found
hint: Node.js setup failed. Verify setup-node action version.

name: exit code 126 - permission/shebang
hint: Permission denied or invalid shebang. Often caused by node -e on Windows Git Bash.
fix: Replace node -e/p/c with node script.mjs pattern

name: gh auth failure
hint: GitHub token issue. Ensure GITHUB_TOKEN is set and has actions:write.
fix: Ensure GITHUB_TOKEN secret is set in repo settings

name: ESM import error
hint: Module resolution error. Check if target file uses ESM correctly.
fix: Check import/export statements in affected module
